entries.title: Psalms 61:1
segments: <<For the Chief Musician; on a stringed instrument. A Psalm of David.>> Hear my cry, O God; Attend unto my prayer.

entries.title: Psalms 61:2
segments: From the end of the earth will I call unto thee, when my heart  is overwhelmed: Lead me to  the rock that is higher than I.

entries.title: Psalms 61:3
segments: For thou hast been a refuge for me, A strong tower from the enemy.

entries.title: Psalms 61:4
segments: I will dwell in thy tabernacle for ever: I will take refuge in the covert of thy wings. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 61:5
segments: For thou, O God, hast heard my vows: Thou hast given [me] the heritage of those that fear thy name.

entries.title: Psalms 61:6
segments: Thou wilt prolong the king's life; His years shall be as many generations.

entries.title: Psalms 61:7
segments: He shall abide before God for ever: Oh prepare lovingkindness and truth, that they may preserve him.

entries.title: Psalms 61:8
segments: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, That I may daily perform my vows.
